questions.q_en: Each of Ravi and Kavita had some marbles. Kavita had 12 more marbles than Ravi had. If each of them had one more marble, then three times the number of marbles Kavita would then have had would have been equal to four times the number of marbles Ravi would then have had. How many marbles did Kavita actually have?
questions.solution_en:
Let number of marbles Ravi had= x .

So kavita had=x+12

If each of them had one more marble then,

kavita had=x+12+1=x+13

similarly Ravi=x+1

and,

3(x + 13) = 4(x + 1)

3x + 39 = 4x + 4

39 - 4 = 4x - 3x

So x =35

So,Ravi=35 and kavita = 35+12=47

option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Find the greatest number of five digits which is divisible by 12, 21, 15 and 30.
questions.solution_en:
Greatest number of 5 digits = 99999

Required number must be divisible by LCM of (12, 21, 15 and 30) which is 420.

Dividing 99999 by 420, we get 39 as remainder.

Required number = (99999 - 39) = 99960

questions.q_en: In the following figure, P and Q are centers of two circles. The circles are intersecting at points A and B. PA produced on both the sides meets the circles at C and D. If ∠CPB = 100°, then find the value of x.
questions.solution_en:
∠CPB = 100°

∠APB = 180 - 100 = 80°

In DAPB,

∠PAB = ∠PBA = ½ (180-80) = 50°

∠BAD = 180 - 50 = 130°

In ABED,

∠BAD + ∠BED = 180° (In cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles is equal to 180°.)

∠BED = 180° - 130° = 50°

∠BQD = 2∠BED (The angle at the center is double the angle at the circumference.)

∠BQD = 2 X 50 = 100°

questions.q_en: Three pipes are attached to a tank, pipe P and Q can fill a tank in 10 hours and 12 hours respectively while pipe R can empty the tank in 60 hours. If all the three pipes are opened together then find the total time it will take to fill the tank.
questions.solution_en:
Let the capacity of the tank = 60 units (LCM of 10, 12 and 60)

Efficiency of pipe P to fill the tank = 60/10 = 6 units/hour

Efficiency of pipe Q to fill the tank = 60/12 = 5 units/hour

Efficiency of pipe R to empty the tank = 60/60 = 1 unit/hour

Required time = 60/(6 + 5 - 1) = 60/10 = 6 hours

questions.q_en: The ratio between the height and radius of the base of a cylinder is 7 : 5. If its volume is 14836.5 cm3, then find its total surface area (take π = 3.14).
questions.solution_en:
Let height and radius of cylinder is '7x' and '5x' respectively.

Volume of cylinder = π22h = 14836.5

3.14 * (5x)2 * 7x = 14836.5

x3 = 27

x = 3

Total surface area of cylinder = 2πr(h + r) = 2 * 3.14 * 5x * (7x + 5x)

= 376.8 * x2

= 376.8 * 32

= 3391.2 cm2

questions.q_en: Three pipes A, B, and C can fill the tank in 8 hours. Pipes B and C together can fill the tank in 16 hours. Find the time taken by pipe A alone to fill the tank.
questions.solution_en:
The capacity of the tank = L.C.M of 8 and 16 = 16

Efficiency = capacity of tank/ time taken

Efficiency of pipes A, B, and C = 16/8 = 2

Efficiency of pipes B and C = 16/16 = 1

Efficiency of pipe A = 2 - 1 = 1

Required time taken = 16/1 = 16 hours

questions.q_en: A class of 40 students has an average score of 70. The teacher discovers that one student's score of 85 was mistakenly recorded as 58. Also, a new student joins with a score of 95. What is the new average of the class?
questions.solution_en:
total students= 40, initial average = 70

Total recorded score = 40 X 70 = 2,800

Wrongly recorded value = 58

Correct value = 85

Thus, Corrected sum after fixing the score of one student = 2,800 - 58 + 85 = 2,827

since, New student's score = 95

so, New total sum= 2,827 + 95 = 2,922

New total number of students = 40 + 1 = 41

Thus, average = 2,922 / 41 = 71.27

questions.q_en: A solid metallic cube of side 9 cm and a solid metallic cuboid having dimensions 5 cm, 13 cm, 31 cm are melted to form a single cube. How much (in ₹) is the cost to polish the new cube at a rate of ₹ 10 per cm2?
questions.solution_en:
The volume of the cube = 93 = 729 cm3

The volume of the cuboid = 5 * 13 * 31 = 2015 cm3

The volume of the new cube = 729 + 2015 = 2744 cm3

The side of the cube = ∛2744 = 14 cm

The surface area of the cube = 6 * 142 = 1176 cm2

Since, the cost of polish the cube = ₹ 10 per cm2

So, the total cost of polishing the cube = 1176 * 10 = ₹11760

questions.q_en: P, Q, and R can do a piece of work in 13 days, 25 days, and 50 days respectively. On day1, P and R work together, on day2, Q and R work together, on day3, P and Q work together, and on day4, all three work together. After 4 days, the part of work remaining is:
questions.solution_en:
Let total work be 13, 25, and 50 = 650 units

Efficiency of P = 650/13 = 50 units per day

Efficiency of Q = 650/25 = 26 units per day

Efficiency of R = 650/50 = 13 units per day

Work done in 4 days = (50 + 13) + (26 + 13) + (50 + 26) + (50 + 26 + 13) = 267

Part of work remaining = 1 - (267/650) = 383/650
